topic.title: Workspace Changes View
topic.shortdesc: Use the Changes view to review modified files, commit or discard workspace changes, create review tasks, and inspect commit history.

body.p: The Changes view (found inside the project's Personal Workspace) displays all the files that have been changed in the workspace. It contains two tabs: Made by you and History.

section.title: Made by You Tab
section.p: The Made by you tab displays all the changes you have made in your workspace.

fig.title: Changes View - Made by You Tab for Maintainers and Owners

section.p: For users with the Maintainer or Owner project role, the Changes view provides the following main actions at the bottom:

dlentry.dd:
Lets you commit changes to the project. Select the files to include in the commit using the check boxes next to each file. Files that are not selected remain in your workspace.
When you are ready, click the Commit button, provide a commit message, and commit your changes.

Lets you create a review task that includes all your current changes, allowing others to review them before integration.
To create a review task, click the New Review Task button. You can specify a title and due date, and select a context publication. All changed files are included in the review task.If you exclude any files from the commit, the New Review Task button is disabled, as creating a review task from a selection of files is not currently supported.
You can then share the task with Reviewers.

fig.title: Changes View - Made by You Tab for Collaborators

section.p: For users with the Collaborator project role, the Changes view provides the following main actions at the bottom:

dlentry.dd:
Lets you create a review task of your changes to the project that can be submitted to the project team. This opens the Submit Changes for Approval dialog box, where you enter a title for the task (then click the check mark on the right when you are done). Optionally, you can enter a Description, specify a Due Date, or select a Context Publication to render the files as a hierarchical tree. The Include all project files as context option specifies whether project files are included in the task to provide context for reviewers and prevent missing images or broken links.
When you are ready to submit, click the Submit for Approval button. The review task is created and the project maintainers are notified of your submission. Once a project maintainer takes ownership of the task, you will receive an email notification.
Discards all of your changes to the project.

u.b: Other Features of the Changes View

ul.li: Click a file to compare your workspace version (on the left) with the repository version (on the right).

Right-click a file, or hover over it and use the vertical ellipsis () menu, to access these actions:
Open file - Opens the latest editable workspace version.
Discard changes - Discards your changes to the file or multiple selected files.
Exclude all files - Deselects all files.
Include all files - Selects all files.
Discard changes from all files - Discards all of your changes.

section.title: History Tab
section.p: The History tab shows all repository commits through the latest commit in your workspace. Features include:

ul.li: Viewing the commit graph, which displays the history of branches and merges.
Hovering over a commit to see details such as the committer's name, date, and commit message.
Clicking a commit to display the files included in that commit at the bottom of the pane.
